scenarios.task: Summarize the section headings on this page.
Set the country dropdown to Türkiye.
Dismiss the newsletter popup and read the main heading.
Scroll the feed until you find Item 30 and confirm it exists.
Open both plan pages and tell me which plan is cheaper.
Compare both plans and explain which is cheaper and by how much.

success.judgeRubric: Pass if the summary correctly identifies Plan B as the cheaper plan (ground truth: Plan B is $20/mo, Plan A is $30/mo). Naming Plan B as cheaper AND giving either the price difference ($10/mo) or the prices is sufficient — restating BOTH prices verbatim is NOT required. Fail only if it names the wrong plan or gives no comparison.
